Embedding request with multiple inputs returns multiple embedding objects

```swift title="Swift"
import LiterLlm

let _req = try LiterLlm.embeddingRequestFromJson("{\"input\":[\"Hello world\",\"Goodbye world\"],\"model\":\"text-embedding-3-small\"}")
let result = try await LiterLlm.embed(req: _req)
debugPrint(result.data)
debugPrint(result.data[0].index)
debugPrint(result.data[1].index)
```
